name: @a4co/root
description: A4CO technical preview monorepo for controlled backend, event-driven and DDD validation.

scripts.env:check: node -v && pnpm -v && docker --version && docker compose version
scripts.build:preview: pnpm --filter @a4co/shared-utils run build && pnpm --filter @a4co/shared-events run build && pnpm --filter @a4co/observability run build && pnpm --filter @a4co/domain-order run build && pnpm --filter @a4co/domain-inventory run build && pnpm --filter @a4co/gateway run build && pnpm --filter @a4co/order-service run build && pnpm --filter @a4co/inventory-service run build
scripts.build:full: pnpm --filter @a4co/shared-utils run build && pnpm --filter @a4co/shared-events run build && pnpm --filter @a4co/observability run build && pnpm --filter @a4co/domain-order run build && pnpm --filter @a4co/domain-payment run build && pnpm --filter @a4co/domain-inventory run build && pnpm --filter @a4co/gateway run build && pnpm --filter @a4co/auth-service run build && pnpm --filter @a4co/order-service run build && pnpm --filter @a4co/product-service run build && pnpm --filter @a4co/inventory-service run build && pnpm --filter @a4co/payment-service run build && pnpm --filter @a4co/user-service run build
scripts.test:preview: pnpm --filter @a4co/gateway run test -- --runInBand && pnpm --filter @a4co/order-service run test -- --runInBand && pnpm --filter @a4co/inventory-service run test -- --runInBand
scripts.test:full: pnpm --filter @a4co/gateway run test -- --runInBand && pnpm --filter @a4co/auth-service run test -- --runInBand && pnpm --filter @a4co/order-service run test -- --runInBand && pnpm --filter @a4co/product-service run test -- --runInBand && pnpm --filter @a4co/inventory-service run test -- --runInBand && pnpm --filter @a4co/payment-service run test -- --runInBand && pnpm --filter @a4co/user-service run test -- --runInBand
scripts.lint:preview: pnpm --filter @a4co/gateway exec eslint "src/**/*.ts" && pnpm --filter @a4co/order-service exec eslint "{src,apps,libs,test}/**/*.ts" --rule "@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any:warn" && pnpm --filter @a4co/inventory-service exec eslint "{src,apps,libs,test}/**/*.ts"
scripts.lint:full: pnpm --filter @a4co/gateway run lint && pnpm --filter @a4co/auth-service run lint && pnpm --filter @a4co/order-service run lint && pnpm --filter @a4co/product-service run lint && pnpm --filter @a4co/inventory-service run lint && pnpm --filter @a4co/payment-service run lint && pnpm --filter @a4co/user-service run lint
scripts.check: pnpm run validate:package && pnpm run env:check && pnpm run lint:preview && pnpm run test:preview && pnpm run build:preview
scripts.check:fast: pnpm run validate:package && pnpm run env:check
scripts.check:full: pnpm run validate:package && pnpm run lint:full && pnpm run test:full && pnpm run build:full
scripts.ci:prepare: pnpm -w run clean && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm run build:preview
scripts.ci:test: pnpm run test:preview && pnpm run lint:preview
scripts.lint:preview:fix: pnpm --filter @a4co/gateway run lint && pnpm --filter @a4co/order-service run lint && pnpm --filter @a4co/inventory-service run lint
